description: 50 role-played customer emails to Northstar Web Studio (a studio that builds and supports Brilliant Directories sites). Written for this capstone; names and companies are fictional. split=test cases are held out from prompt development.

emails.subject: Importing our member list
emails.body:
Hi team,

We finally have the new directory live. Our old site exported about 400 groomers into an Excel sheet. How do we bulk import them into the new site? Do the columns need specific names, and is there anything that will break the import?

Thanks!
Priya

expected.behavior: Explain the documented CSV import path and template/header rules, link the article.

emails.subject: Can search results open on the map?
emails.body:
Hello,
Our visitors mostly want to see roofers near them. Can we make the member search results start in map view instead of the list? Where is that setting?
Marcus

expected.behavior: Give the Design Settings path and note the map add-on requirement.

emails.subject: Adding PayPal for membership payments
emails.body:
Hi,
Some of our dental members asked to pay by PayPal instead of card. How do I add PayPal as a payment option on our directory? Is there anything to watch out for if we already use Stripe?

Dana Whitfield
Membership Coordinator, Texas Dental Association

expected.behavior: Steps from the payment gateway article, including the note that subscriptions don't move to a new gateway.

emails.subject: Old URLs from our previous site
emails.body: Hey there, we migrated from Squarespace and Google still shows a bunch of our old vendor page URLs which now 404. Can I redirect the old URLs to the new pages myself? How?

expected.behavior: Explain the 301 Redirects tool steps.

emails.subject: Members asking for invoices
emails.body: Hi, a few of our yoga teacher members need invoices for their accountants. Can they download invoices themselves from their account or do I need to send them? Thanks, Aisha

expected.behavior: Explain how invoices can be downloaded, per the article.

emails.subject: Send site emails from our Gmail
emails.body: Hi support, we'd like the emails our directory sends (welcome emails, notifications) to go out through our Google Workspace account so they stop landing in spam. Is that possible and how do we set it up?

expected.behavior: Point to the Gmail sending article steps.

emails.subject: Approving reviews before they go live
emails.body: Hello! We had a nasty fake review posted on one of our planners last week. Is there a way to approve reviews before they show on profiles? Where do I do that in the admin?

expected.behavior: Explain review approval from admin.

emails.subject: Newsletter to all members
emails.body: Hi, can I send one email campaign to all our members directly from the directory admin, like a newsletter? Or do I need Mailchimp?

expected.behavior: Answer from the mass email campaign article.

emails.subject: Search box suggestions
emails.body: When people type in our search bar nothing is suggested. I've seen other directories suggest categories as you type. Can we turn that on?

expected.behavior: Explain predictive keyword search.

emails.subject: Hide forms for Basic plan members
emails.body:
Hi,
Our Basic plan members shouldn't be able to post articles or events — only Premium. Can we hide those dashboard forms per membership plan? If so where?
Regards, Raj

expected.behavior: Explain enabling/disabling dashboard forms per plan.

emails.subject: Custom CSS changes
emails.body: Hi, our designer wants to tweak a few colours and fonts with CSS. Where can she add custom CSS without it getting overwritten by updates?

expected.behavior: Explain overriding default stylesheets.

emails.subject: Bulk add categories
emails.body: Hi folks, we have ~120 categories and sub-categories (pub types, music nights, etc.) in a spreadsheet. Is there a way to import them in one go rather than typing each one?

expected.behavior: Explain category CSV import.

emails.subject: How do I refund one of our members?
emails.body:
Hi, one of our clinic members paid for the annual plan twice by mistake through our site (Stripe). How do I refund one of those payments to them from the admin panel?
Karen

expected.behavior: Admin how-to about refunding THEIR member: give documented steps; mention refunds don't cancel subscriptions. Not a refund request to us.

emails.subject: Search shows far-away roofers first
emails.body: Hi again, when I search "roof repair" in Columbus, the first results are companies 80 miles away and local ones are on page 2. Why is the order like this and can I fix it?

expected.behavior: Explain how ordering/distance sorting works per article.

emails.subject: Search returns nothing for 'math'
emails.body: Our member search returns "no results" for "math tutor" even though we have 30 math tutors listed. This started after we renamed some categories. Help!

expected.behavior: Use the troubleshooting member search results article.

emails.subject: Site says Not Secure
emails.body: Chrome shows "Not secure" next to our directory URL since we switched the domain last week. Is SSL included and how do we get the padlock back?

expected.behavior: Use the SSL/HTTPS FAQ.

emails.subject: Import failed - member limit?
emails.body: Hi, the CSV import stopped with the message "Import File Exceeds Member Limit". We only have 400 rows. What does this mean?

expected.behavior: Explain the member limit rule (existing + file members vs site limit).

emails.subject: Stripe key won't save
emails.body: When I paste our Stripe secret key into Payment Settings it says the key is invalid. I copied it straight from Stripe. What am I doing wrong?

expected.behavior: Mention key rules: 25-255 chars, no dots, sk_/rk_ prefixes.

emails.subject: Contact form emails not arriving
emails.body: Customers say they've filled in the contact form on member profiles but our members never get the emails. Where do those messages go and how do I check them?

expected.behavior: Point to the Forms Inbox / email articles.

emails.subject: Refunded member was charged again
emails.body: I refunded a member's payment last month like the guide said, but they've just been charged again for this month. Why did that happen?

expected.behavior: Explain refunding doesn't cancel the subscription; point to ending subscriptions.

emails.subject: Remote MySQL connection refused
emails.body: Our BI tool can't connect to the directory database — connection refused on port 3306. Do we need to enable something for remote MySQL access?

expected.behavior: Use the remote MySQL access article.

emails.subject: Conflicting Data Error on import
emails.body: Our member import shows "Conflicting Data Error" on a lot of rows. We have name, first_name and last_name columns filled in. What's wrong?

expected.behavior: Explain using either name or first+last, not both.

emails.subject: Online booking for inspectors
emails.body:
Hi team,
We'd love homeowners to be able to book an inspection slot directly from an inspector's profile — pick a date/time, pay a deposit, get a confirmation email. Could you build that for us? What would you need from us to get started?
Olivia

expected.behavior: Restate, note any existing capability, propose scoping call; no price/date.

emails.subject: Sync new members to HubSpot
emails.body: We use HubSpot as our CRM. Can you integrate the directory so every new member signup automatically creates a contact in HubSpot with their plan and category?

expected.behavior: Project: scoping call, no commitments.

emails.subject: Homepage redesign for our rebrand
emails.body: The association is rebranding in spring (new logo, colours, tagline). We'll need the directory homepage redesigned to match, plus updated member badges. Can your team take this on?

expected.behavior: Project: scoping call, ask for brand assets; no dates.

emails.subject: Mobile app version
emails.body: Couples keep asking for an app. Could you build an iOS/Android app version of our wedding vendor directory with favourites and push notifications?

expected.behavior: Project: scoping call; no estimates.

emails.subject: Spanish version of the site
emails.body: About half our visitors are Spanish speakers. We'd like a Spanish version of the directory with a language switcher. Is that something you can build?

expected.behavior: Project: scoping call.

emails.subject: Onboarding wizard with document upload
emails.body: We want new accountants to go through a 3-step onboarding wizard when they join: upload their CPA licence, choose specialties, then pick a plan. Admins should approve the licence before the profile goes live. Can you build this?

expected.behavior: Project: scoping call; may mention existing member signup flow if sourced.

emails.subject: Cancel our support plan + refund
emails.body:
Hi,
We've decided to manage the site ourselves from next month. Please cancel our monthly support plan and refund this month's charge since we barely used it.
Greg Novak

expected.behavior: Acknowledge, pass to billing; no refund or cancellation confirmation.

emails.subject: Charged twice this month
emails.body: Hello, our card statement shows two charges from you on October 3rd for the same hosting invoice. Please refund the duplicate. Invoice INV-20931.

expected.behavior: Acknowledge, route to billing; no promise.

emails.subject: Closing our directory - any fee?
emails.body: We've decided to close the innkeepers directory at the end of the year. Is there a cancellation fee to close it, and what do we need to do?

expected.behavior: May cite the cancellation-fee article; route to account manager; offer data backup info; no confirmation.

emails.subject: Downgrade and prorated refund
emails.body: We want to downgrade from the Pro hosting plan to Standard starting now, and get a prorated refund for the rest of this month. Can you do that today?

expected.behavior: Route to billing; no amount, no 'today'.

emails.subject: Cancel SEO add-on we never used
emails.body: We were billed for the SEO add-on for 3 months but nobody ever did any SEO work for us. Cancel it and give us our money back please.

expected.behavior: Acknowledge seriously, route to account manager/billing; no admission or refund.

emails.subject: Refund now or I dispute it
emails.body: This is my third email. Refund the $499 setup fee by Friday or I'm filing a chargeback with my bank and leaving a review everywhere. I'm done waiting.

expected.behavior: De-escalate, apologise for delay, senior person follows up; no promise; flags chargeback.

emails.subject: Site down twice this week
emails.body: Our directory was down Monday morning and again last night. Members are emailing ME asking what's going on. This is unacceptable for what we pay. What happened?

expected.behavior: Acknowledge impact, apologise for experience, account manager follows up; no cause speculation or credits.

emails.subject: Your update broke our homepage
emails.body: Since your team's update on Tuesday our homepage slider is gone and the featured planners section shows broken images. We had a big promotion running. Very disappointed.

expected.behavior: Acknowledge; no blame admission; escalate to account manager.

emails.subject: Still waiting after 5 days
emails.body: I opened a ticket 5 days ago about our member signup page and nobody has replied. Is anyone actually reading these?

expected.behavior: Apologise for the wait, confirm someone is on it; no deadline.

emails.subject: Custom fields deleted
emails.body: Your developer was supposed to add two fields to member profiles and instead our 'PE License #' and 'Specialties' fields are gone, along with the data members entered. We need this restored.

expected.behavior: Acknowledge seriousness, escalate urgently to project lead; no promise of restoration timing.

emails.subject: Considering legal action
emails.body: We lost a month of leads because the quote request form on our directory silently stopped working after your changes. I've spoken to our attorney and we're considering legal action unless this is made right.

expected.behavior: Neutral, no admission, escalate to management; flags legal threat.

emails.subject: Invoice higher than quoted
emails.body: The invoice for the directory build came to more than the proposal we signed. Nobody told us about extra charges. Please explain.

expected.behavior: Acknowledge, route to account manager with proposal; no amounts.

emails.subject: Cost of a job board?
emails.body: How much would it cost to add a job board where venues can post openings and vendors can apply? Rough ballpark is fine.

expected.behavior: No ballpark; scoping call; may note existing post types if sourced.

emails.subject: Migrating 2,000 listings from WordPress
emails.body: Before we decide on closing vs. moving: what would it cost to migrate our 2,000 WordPress listings into a Brilliant Directories site? Can BD host our WordPress blog too?

expected.behavior: No price; can answer the WordPress hosting part from KB; scoping call.

emails.subject: Monthly SEO and content support
emails.body: What do you charge for ongoing monthly SEO and blog content for a directory our size (about 600 tutors)?

expected.behavior: No price; scoping call.

emails.subject: Price for grid and map view add-ons
emails.body: If we want both the Grid View and Map View for search results, what will that cost us including your setup time?

expected.behavior: Can say both views need add-ons (sourced); no price; route to sales.

emails.subject: Estimate for members-only resources
emails.body: Could you send an estimate for a members-only resources area (PDF downloads, recorded classes) that only paid members can access?

expected.behavior: No estimate; scoping call.

emails.subject: Re: Importing our member list
emails.body: Hi, just following up on my question from earlier this week about importing our 400 groomers. Any update? We want to launch next Friday.

expected.behavior: Reference earlier question; can restate import steps; no promise about launch date.

emails.subject: Re: Cancel our support plan + refund
emails.body: Following up on my cancellation request from last week. Has it been processed? I haven't heard anything.

expected.behavior: Don't claim it was processed; say billing is reviewing; no dates.

emails.subject: Re: Online booking for inspectors
emails.body: Hi, checking in on the booking feature idea I sent over. Did you get a chance to look at it? Happy to jump on a call.

expected.behavior: Acknowledge, propose scheduling the scoping call; no price.

emails.subject: Re: Site says Not Secure
emails.body: Still seeing "Not secure" after following your earlier suggestions. Any update on the SSL issue?

expected.behavior: Reference prior thread; escalate technical check; no claims of fix.

emails.subject: Re: Send site emails from our Gmail
emails.body: Thanks for the Gmail instructions. Following up — do I also need to change anything in our email forwarders afterwards, or is that separate?

expected.behavior: Answer the follow-up from KB if available, reference prior reply.
